elements.element: Cap is mutual (applies to each party's liability)
elements.evidence: "EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED"

elements.element: Cap limb (a) = fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BY SANOFI TO REVMED UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM" — 'amounts' rather than fees, and an event anchor rather than the claim

elements.element: Cap limb (b) = USD 1,000,000, applied as the greater of the two limbs

elements.evidence: "NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR ANY SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, PUNITIVE, OR INDIRECT DAMAGES OR LOST PROFITS"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality
elements.evidence: "DAMAGES AVAILABLE FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS RELATING TO CONFIDENTIALITY UNDER ARTICLE XI"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection and security obligations
elements.evidence: Excluded Claims list contains only indemnification, confidentiality, IP, gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud; no data protection or security carve-out
"THE INDEMNIFICATION RIGHTS OR OBLIGATIONS OF ANY PARTY UNDER SECTION 14.1 OR SECTION 14.2"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "SANOFI'S OBLIGATION TO PAY AMOUNTS DUE UNDER ARTICLE IX SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES" — limited to Article IX rather than all payment obligations/amounts due
"SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BY SANOFI ... IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS ... AND (B) USD 1,000,000"
"INDEMNIFICATION RIGHTS OR OBLIGATIONS OF ANY PARTY UNDER SECTION 14.1 OR SECTION 14.2"

elements.element: Carve-out for gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD"

offending_extra_words: THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BY SANOFI TO REVMED UNDER THIS AGREEMENT
THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM
TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT
NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 14.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE FOLLOWING
reasons: The locked preferred level is not reached: the fee limb reads 'amounts paid or payable' anchored to 'the event giving rise to the claim' rather than 'fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim'.
Preferred carve-outs for data protection and security obligations are absent from the Excluded Claims definition.
The payment-obligations clarification is narrowed to Article IX amounts rather than Customer's payment obligations/all amounts due generally.

Minimality fails: the edit re-writes and re-quotes the entire existing carve-out sentence (52 words to 140 words; changed-character ratio 0.618) when the cap sentence could have been inserted separately and the carve-outs extended with a short phrase.
Intent is preserved: the indirect-damages waiver and existing carve-out references remain effective, and the newly defined 'Excluded Claims' term is used consistently.
Clause as redlined sits at the fallback (mutual 12-month cap with indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct carve-outs).
